svg.title: Police officer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as police officer, wearing a work uniform and a service cap. Visible work cue: A two-way radio with antenna stands beside a separate plain shield badge. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a service cap.
